title: Create an Accessibility Business Case
description: Draft a one‑page business case to persuade leadership to invest in accessibility.
problemStatement:
## Draft a Business Case

Imagine you work for a mid‑sized e‑commerce company. Your website has no accessibility considerations. Write a one‑page business case to present to the CTO or CEO, covering:

- The market opportunity (size of disability population, spending power).
- Legal risk (cite at least one real lawsuit example and potential fines).
- SEO benefits (how a11y boosts search rankings).
- Brand reputation (inclusive companies are trusted).
- Competitive advantage (how being accessible can differentiate).
- A proposed low‑investment first step (e.g., an audit + fix 10 critical issues).

Format as a short document with clear headings. Use persuasive language backed by facts (you can research statistics).

This is practice for a real conversation you may need to have.
hints: Start with a compelling stat: '1 in 4 adults in the US has a disability.'
Mention the cost of a lawsuit vs the cost of fixing accessibility.
Propose a specific, small pilot project to reduce perceived risk.
expectedOutput: A one‑page business case document (plain text or Markdown).
solutionCode:
# Business Case: Investing in Web Accessibility

## The Opportunity
- Over 1.3 billion people globally have a disability, with a combined annual disposable income of $1.9 trillion.
- 71% of customers with disabilities will leave a website that is not accessible.

## Legal Risk
- Over 3,500 ADA website lawsuits were filed in 2023 alone.
- Average settlement ranges from $10,000 to $50,000; legal fees can double this.
- The EU Accessibility Act will require compliance by 2025 for our products sold in Europe.

## SEO & Performance
- Semantic HTML and alt text improve search ranking and page load speed.
- An accessible site can see up to a 30% increase in organic traffic.

## Brand & Trust
- 82% of consumers say they would purchase from an inclusive brand.
- Accessibility shows commitment to all customers, enhancing loyalty.

## Competitive Advantage
- Most of our competitors are not fully accessible; we can lead the market.

## Proposed First Step
- Invest $X in a baseline accessibility audit and fix the top 10 critical issues within 30 days.
- This will immediately reduce legal risk and improve the experience for thousands of potential customers.

## Call to Action
Let's schedule a 30‑minute meeting to discuss the roadmap and allocate resources.
